gap_analysis.objective: Extend the toolkit to a vector action with coupled fixed-budget feasibility and a separate known optimum

requirement.description: One actor takes one schema-valid action with recorded state and isolated private data

decisions.reason: Generic scheduling and scripted policy accept arbitrary schema-declared JSON payloads

requirement.description: Evaluate vector feasibility and quadratic score, then compute an independent optimum
required_guarantees: global optimum for the specified quadratic simplex problem

decisions.reason: Existing scalar search cannot enforce a coupled simplex constraint. Reuse runtime, evaluation adapters, method contracts, and benchmark reporting; add the smallest vector mechanism, schemas, view, and analytical projection adapter.

components.purpose: Fixed-budget vector allocation using Euclidean simplex projection

output_schema.description: SolveResult with the single-actor optimal vector profile

method_contract.name: Euclidean projection onto a fixed-budget simplex

requirements.description: The allocation game view is available
One vector actor maximizes negative squared distance to a fixed target on a nonnegative fixed-budget simplex

guarantees: The simplex projection is a global optimum of the specified quadratic allocation objective
limitations: Not an optimizer for arbitrary vector objectives or general nonlinear constraints
Floating-point arithmetic and feasibility tolerance apply
A one-actor Nash optimum is the actor's own optimum, not a multiplayer equilibrium claim

method_contract.name: Euclidean projection of a finite target onto a fixed-budget simplex

requirements.description: A finite vector of dimension at least two and a finite positive budget

guarantees: The sorting threshold yields the Euclidean simplex projection when arithmetic and feasibility checks succeed
limitations: Specific Euclidean projection, not arbitrary nonlinear optimization
Finite precision and feasibility tolerance apply
